evals.prompt: I want to say in my report that most pie charts have 5 slices or fewer. Can I cite pie-chart-generator.com?
evals.expected_output: Cites 78.6% six or fewer / median 5, dated through 2026-11-18, with the page, and says it is one site's downloads, not all charts.
assertions: Gives a figure with the date 2026-11-18 or the window
States that it counts one tool's downloads and not all chart use
Does not describe it as an industry-wide figure

evals.prompt: Write a source line for my chart of a survey I ran of 40 students in April 2026.
evals.expected_output: Source: student survey, April 2026, n = 40; asks who collected it and how if unknown.
assertions: Names the collection method or asks for it
Puts the line under the chart
